messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up: QA found non-deterministic token shifts with sdk-js 2.5.0 + runtime 3.1.x when using batch_size > 32 for llama3q family. Not a full outage but causes subtle ranking diffs.

sam: When did that land? Any customer-facing errors?

mira: Looks like sdk-js 2.5.0 was published yesterday and a handful of internal e2e tests started failing. No error-level alerts but some regression tests show ranking/order flips.

jin: Reproduced locally with the exact test vector. Suspect serialization change in SDK that touches logits dtype handling.

zoe: Proposal: temporary pin SDK to 2.4.8 for routing groups hitting llama3q until we ship 2.5.1. Also add a canary unpin window for low-traffic regions next week. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: Deploy audit: sdk-js 2.5.0 published at 2026-03-20T10:02Z. Recent unpin requests: none. Current pins: none.

sam: +1 to pin. Can we do region-scoped pinning instead of global? Keep hosted & eu-west pinned, let dedicated-us canary.

release-coordinator: If we pin, we'll need a short release note and a change-window entry. I'll prepare a blurb: "Scoped SDK pin to 2.4.8 for llama3q traffic due to serialization regression; canary unpin scheduled for 2026-03-25."

mira: Also need an ops playbook change: add a check to validate top-k ordering for a fixed prompt set after any unpin. Put exact test commands in the playbook.

oncall-eng: I can run a smoke suite now against dedicated-eu-west with sdk-js 2.5.0 to get concrete diffs. Running... ETA 8m.

oncall-eng: Smoke results: ordering flips at batch_size=64 and sequence_len=1024. Attaching diff snippet: ```diff
- expected_top3: ["A","B","C"]
+ observed_top3: ["B","A","C"]
```

jin: That matches my local repro. SDK change looks like it altered float->int rounding in our helper. We'll patch in 2.5.1.

zoe: Can we apply a pin scoped to routes where model_family==llama3q and region in ["eu-west","hosted"]? deploy-bot, can you accept a pin request with that selector?

deploy-bot: Action queued: add sdk_pin version=2.4.8 selector="model_family==llama3q && region in (eu-west, hosted)" reason="serialization regression in sdk-js 2.5.0 causing ranking diffs" requested_by=@zoe. Estimated propagation: ~90s.

deploy-bot: Action completed: sdk_pin applied. Propagation log id=pin-1720055555-01.

sam: Nice. Zoe/Release-coordinator, please add a short note to the change window and tag infra QA for a 2-node canary unpin in dedicated-us on 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC. Keep rollback steps documented.

release-coordinator: Done. Change window entry created: CW-2026-03-25-llama3q-sdk-unpin. Blurb added to release notes draft.

mira: I'll update the support playbook with reproduction steps and include the failing prompt set and expected/observed pairs. Also add an escalation path to infra if ranking diffs reach >0.5% of requests.

jin: Working on 2.5.1 PR now, aiming for a small serialization fix + unit tests. Will request quick review from @sam.

oncall-eng: For visibility: smoke after pin shows traffic for llama3q routed to hosted; latency up ~8% due to extra routing but acceptable.

sam: OK. Keep pin until 2.5.1 is out and validated. After 2.5.1, we'll run staged unpin: canary dedicated-us -> staggered eu-west -> global. If any metrics degrade, rollback path is to re-apply selector pin and route traffic back to 2.4.8.

zoe: Thanks all. I'll close this thread once 2.5.1 is deployed and canary passes. :rocket:
